Wingless LM-lane North Star

Characterize which bounded state observables and resource-response laws remain invariant under controlled substrate changes, under fixed resources and preregistered scientific controls. Preserve exact negative results. Change one experimental dimension at a time. No post-result threshold, seed, metric, budget, or interpretation retuning. No live activation, broker access, accepted-ref mutation, or cross-lane authority.
